description_en: Queries the alert rules of a DTS task by calling DescribeJobMonitorRule
description_zh: 调用DescribeJobMonitorRule查询DTS任务的告警规则
kebab_example: aliyun dts describe-job-monitor-rule --dts-job-id ta7w132u12h0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeJobMonitorRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html to obtain the task ID
parameters.help_zh: 迁移、同步或订阅任务ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html获取
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en: The region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: DTS实例所属的地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

Code.description_en: The error code. This parameter will be deprecated
Code.description_zh: 错误码，本参数即将下线

DtsJobId.description_en: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message used to replace the %s placeholder in the ErrMessage response parameter.
For example, if ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, the request parameter DtsJobId is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的%s。
如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid.

MonitorRules.description_en: The monitoring rule information of the DTS task

items.description_en: The monitoring rule information of the DTS task

DelayRuleTime.description_en: The threshold that triggers a latency alert. Unit: seconds
DelayRuleTime.description_zh: 触发延迟告警的阈值，单位为秒

JobType.description_en:
The task type of the DTS instance. Valid values:
normal: data migration or data synchronization task.
full_check: associated full data validation task.
etl_check: associated incremental data validation task
JobType.description_zh:
DTS实例的任务类型，取值：
normal：迁移或同步任务。
full_check：关联的全量校验任务。
etl_check：关联的增量校验任务

Period.description_en:
The statistical period of the incremental data validation task. Unit: minutes.

Valid values: 1, 5, 10, and 30 minutes
Period.description_zh:
增量校验任务的统计周期，单位为分钟。

当前支持取值为1分钟、5分钟、10分钟和30分钟

Phone.description_en: The phone numbers of the contacts to be notified when an alert is triggered. Multiple phone numbers are separated by commas (,)
Phone.description_zh: 告警触发后需通知的联系人手机号码，多个手机号码之间以英文逗号（,）分隔

State.description_en:
Indicates whether the monitoring rule is enabled. Valid values:

Y: enabled.
N: disabled
State.description_zh:
是否启用监控规则，返回值：

Y：启用。
N：不启用

Times.description_en: The number of periods for the incremental data validation task
Times.description_zh: 增量校验任务的周期数

Type.description_en:
The type of the monitoring rule. Valid values:
delay: latency alert.
error: anomaly alert.
full_timeout: alert for the runtime of the full data module.
warn: notification alert (the task succeeded but the result did not meet expectations)
Type.description_zh:
监控规则的类型，返回值：
delay：延迟告警。
error：异常告警。
full_timeout：全量模块运行耗时告警。
warn：通知类告警（任务执行成功，结果未达到预期）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值：
true：请求成功。
false：请求失败

items.description_en: The Kafka topic used when data is synchronized or migrated to Kafka
